title: Oral health and economic impact of the Special Olympics Special Smiles screening and referral program
html: People with intellectual and developmental disabilities experience high rates of untreated oral disease and lower dental care use than the general population. Special Olympics Special Smiles (SOSS) provides community-based dental screenings, oral hygiene instruction, and referrals to improve access to care. This study estimated the oral health and economic impact of SOSS screening and referral activities.
